Chief_Complaint.content: Wheeze and shortness of breath for 2 days after heavy dust exposure while cleaning

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Wheeze and shortness of breath began approximately 1 hour after heavy dust exposure while cleaning
Symptoms have been progressive and are worse at night
Patient has difficulty completing sentences due to symptoms
Patient reports no dizziness or vertigo
Oral intake is adequate at approximately 4–5 glasses of water per day
House dust identified as trigger for current symptoms

Past_Medical_History.content: History of childhood asthma with occasional exertional symptoms

Medications.content: Salbutamol inhaler, not used for a couple of months

Assessment.content: Wheeze and shortness of breath, likely asthma exacerbation versus dust-induced allergic reaction
